mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.member_name, m.email, m.phone, m.role, m.use_yn, m.created_at, m.updated_at, ms.social_id, ms.provider, ms.provider_user_id FROM member_social ms INNER JOIN member m ON ms.member_id = m.member_id WHERE ms.provider = #{provider} AND ms.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_name, email, role, use_yn, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberName}, #{email}, 'USER', 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO member_social ( member_id, provider, provider_user_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET member_name = #{memberName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
